The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_class business. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. That implies we might need to cancel existing booking? Or maybe they want to book a new flight? They say "arrange a flight on booking number 1234" - maybe they want to modify booking? But we can interpret as they want to book a flight for that booking ID. We need to compute cost. We need to get flight cost. Then maybe add insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

We need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then compute total payable amount. We might need to get credit card balance? Not necessary. Just provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then compute total. Let's do that.
